text:
Anika B.: Heads up — quick UX spotcheck for the on‑prem connectivity/checker flow in the Private setup wizard. I pushed a small Figma update. Main ideas: move the interactive port checks earlier, give clearer 'what we will do' copy before starting checks, and reduce microcopy friction for non-network folks. Thoughts?

Maya P.: Love moving port checks earlier — users expect confirmation before they exit the screen. Can we show a one‑line summary of required network rules at the top (collapsed by default)? Example: ‘Outbound 443, NTP, and access from admin IPs’. :+1:

Liam R.: Agree. One concern: some customers run the private control plane air‑gapped, so we need a clear opt‑out for automated checks and a manual checklist view. Maybe a toggle: `Run automatic connectivity checks` (on/off) + a link to manual steps.

Sam K.: +1 to the toggle. For copy, suggest wording: ‘Run connectivity checks now — these tests attempt short-lived outbound connections to verify firewall/NAT rules. No data is stored.’ Short and privacy‑friendly.

Anika B.: Nice. Can we shorten the ‘what we will do’ bullets to single lines so they're scannable? Something like:
• Verify outbound 443/80
• Ping metrics/registry endpoints
• Test SSH reachability from admin IPs
• Validate ingress for webhooks on 9200

Maya P.: Also accessibility nit: status updates during checks should be announced to screen readers. Add an `aria-live="polite"` region and avoid just color to indicate pass/fail. Use icons + textual status (Passed / Failed / Skipped).

infra-bot: preflight-checker: run started (attempting 4 tests)

Liam R.: For the UI layout: consider a two-column responsive card — left: checklist + copy, right: live progress and terminal/log output. On small screens stack them. Keeps the action visible.

Sam K.: Copy tweak for failures: instead of ‘Contact support’, say ‘Follow these steps and re-run checks. If issues persist, contact support with the diagnostics bundle.’ Then show a Download diagnostics button. Less dead‑end.

Maya P.: UX microcopy for buttons: replace ambiguous ‘Retry’ with ‘Re‑run checks’ and avoid using ‘Next’ until all required steps are completed. Also add microcopy under the toggle: ‘Automated checks may attempt transient outbound connections’.

Anika B.: OK actionable list: 1) Add toggle + manual checklist view (Liam/Sam) 2) Top collapsed summary of required rules (Maya) 3) Accessibility: aria‑live + text labels (Maya) 4) Button copy changes and failure flow copy (Sam) 5) Ensure opt‑out persists per org (Liam). I'll update Figma and PR description. Anyone want to pick up a small copy pass?

Sam K.: I can do the copy pass and draft the failure messages + diagnostics button text.

Maya P.: I’ll wire the aria regions and update the component states in Figma.

Liam R.: I’ll add the toggle state to the wizard API and ensure the preflight job accepts an `opt_out_checks` flag. Quick snippet for the agent check CLI that we can show in help:
```
# quick port check
nc -vz $HOST 443 || echo 'port 443 blocked'
# http check
curl -I https://registry.redwoodai.internal || echo 'http inaccessible'
```

Anika B.: Perfect. I'll file the PR with the Figma link + copy suggestions. Thanks all. :sparkles:
